label: Which Gemini models Draft with AI offers and falls back to
description_nl: choices: the models offered in the key form (a model released later can still be typed). default_model: used when none is chosen. The '-latest' names come first because Google refuses fixed versions such as gemini-2.5-flash to NEW keys ('no longer available to new users'), so a fixed default breaks for exactly the people just arriving. preference: when the chosen model is refused, the key test tries these in order among the models the key can see. model_id_pattern: what a model id can look like at all — anything else is a typo, refused on save.
weight_basis: Portal business setting of the Training & Video Portal. The knobs ARE the policy — edit them here, never in Python.
